samples.label: Boguslawsky Crater Rim & Terraces
samples.description: Sub-meter high-resolution orbital observation showing impact crater rim, terraced walls, and localized micro-craters.

samples.label: South Pole Shackleton Rim (PSR)
samples.description: High-contrast polar observation showing sunlit peaks adjacent to deep permanently shadowed regions (PSRs) potential volatile cold-traps.

samples.label: Mare Regolith & Fresh Ejecta Rays
samples.description: Terrain Mapping Camera-2 stereo observation displaying immature high-albedo ejecta ray blankets over basaltic mare regolith.

samples.label: Tycho Crater Central Peak & Boulders
samples.description: High-resolution orbital observation of the central peak complex of Tycho Crater, exhibiting massive boulder fields and impact melt flows.

samples.label: Bürg Crater Terraced Wall Slopes
samples.description: Steep terraced scarps and granular mass-wasting on the inner rim walls of complex impact crater Bürg.

samples.label: Fresh Impact Crater with Radial High-Albedo Rays
samples.description: Morphologically pristine young impact crater showing asymmetric continuous ejecta blanket and high-reflectance optical rays.

samples.label: Peary Polar Crater Permanent Shadow & Illumination
samples.description: Extreme low-angle solar illumination revealing permanent shadowed floors and adjacent quasi-permanently illuminated crater rim peaks.

samples.label: Bullialdus Crater Central Mountain Complex
samples.description: Deep-seated crustal bedrock excavated from lunar highlands and exposed along the central peak summit of Bullialdus Crater.

samples.label: Copernicus Basin Multispectral Ray System
samples.description: Calibrated 7-band multispectral composite displaying extensive titanium and iron composition across the ejecta blanket of Copernicus.

samples.label: Ancient Heavily Cratered Lunar Highlands
samples.description: Highland terrain saturated with millions of years of overlapping impacts, illustrating space weathering and fine-grained regolith cover.
